title: Composer Action Bar Visual QA
principle: The action bar must feel compact, calm, Open WebUI-like and useful on the first chat screen across desktop and mobile.
public_repo_rule: Visual evidence is selector, layout and copy metadata only. It contains no prompts, responses, tokens, provider keys, pairing codes, billing data or private telemetry.

expected: tool cluster and live cluster sit in separate grid areas when space allows
Auto review and 5.5 Extra high are compact mode chips instead of large text-heavy buttons
composer feedback occupies its own row and cannot squeeze chips
composer feedback line is visible but secondary
resource chip is a clickable control, not decorative text
tool and live clusters stay in compact single rows without overlap
mode and live chips keep stable tap targets with horizontal overflow only when needed
heavier MMIR++ and Vision controls stay available in the full dock but do not dominate the clean first screen
feedback text remains readable without pushing the chat down

copy_contract: Ready: free browser helper first, local model when connected.
Model picker opened. Free/browser/local routes stay first.
Node dashboard opened. CPU/RAM and model health come only from a paired local node.
